profile.headline: Thankful for the Opportunities
profile.summary:
Diligence --> Persistence --> Patience --> Excellence.

Internal drive for Excellence; experience leveraging Sound Engineering Practices and Processes to develop Modernized Global Security Solutions.

positions.title: Security Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · YAML · DevSecOps

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
Development of specialized Cyber Threat Intelligence solutions.

The solutions leverage modern API practices, Big Data collections of global cyber threat information, and defense-in-depth security practices.

Hands-on technical experience with all phases of enterprise-scale solution delivery life cycle, including; 
- conceptual design 
- proof of concept design and delivery
- executive buy-in
- cross-organizational collaboration
- Go-to-Market & strategic placement strategy
- Field delivery
- Product/Solution O&M support
- Growth strategic development (includes RFI and targeted addressable market)
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) · Data Structures · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Bash · Transport Layer Security (TLS) · Application Security · Big Data Analytics · Big Data · Data Warehousing · MySQL · Hadoop · PKI · Web Application Security · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: PKI Engineering Leader
positions.description:
Product leader of Cryptographic services including AppSec, CustomSec, & InfraSec.

- Define Cryptographic service architecture, integrations, features, and priorities.
- Engage with customers, vendors, and cryptographic stakeholders to realize PKI service level agreements.
- Manage cost accounting including; CapEx , OpEx, Vendor contracts for PKI activities.
- Charter consulting services engagements tasked with enabling secure and sound Cryptographic service practices.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Cloud (On-Prem) and Computer Network Security Consulting.

positions.title: Staff Augment
positions.description: Cloud (On-Prem) and Computer Network Security Development.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
* Experience developing, testing, and validating a Host Based Security Solution and Defense-in-Depth Security Solutions.

* Experience leveraging System Life Cycle Development principles and industry best practices. Including Requirements Gathering, Patch, Change and Configuration Management processes.

* Certifications in Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) practices, McAfee ePO, VSE, ASE, & RSD.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Performed as a Assistant Supply Chain Manager:

* To assist in the analysis and assessment of MMO’s performance metrics to in order to align performance with Eagle Alliance business goals and objectives.
* Through collaboration with the Senior Procurement Professional to coordinate requisitions, issue purchase orders, contracts and other documents vital to the purchasing function.

positions.title: Child Care Specialist
positions.description:
* Supported the achievement of residential, treatment care, and academic goals for at risk youth. Also implemented support system to aid residents in the achievement of goals. 

* Mentored under privileged youth, by providing academic support, moral support, and guidance, applicable to real world situations.
